triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: Believing himself to be the illegitimate son of Fyodor Pavlovitch (there is evidence of this)

triples.subject: Grigory
triples.quote: He was disrespectful to the servant Grigory and his wife, who had cared for him in his childhood.

triples.subject: Ivan Karamazov
triples.quote: the equally startling evidence given in court to-day by the elder of the prisoner’s brothers, who had believed in his guilt

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: He told me himself that he had helped Fyodor Pavlovitch to put the notes in the envelope.

triples.subject: Karamazov
triples.quote: leapt off the fence a minute later to the assistance of Grigory after he had, in his excitement, knocked him down.

triples.subject: Karamazov
triples.quote: a witness saw the prisoner running out of the garden with a weapon in his hand, and was knocked down by him

triples.subject: Karamazov
triples.quote: the dreadful state of the prisoner’s mind at Mokroe when love again lay before him calling him to new life

triples.subject: Ivan Karamazov
triples.quote: the elder of the prisoner’s brothers, who had believed in his guilt, but has to-day produced a bundle of notes and proclaimed Smerdyakov as the murderer.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: Believing himself to be the illegitimate son of Fyodor Pavlovitch (there is evidence of this), he might well have resented his position, compared with that of his master’s legitimate sons.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: suppose for one moment I agreed with the prosecution that my luckless client had stained his hands with his father’s blood.

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: They had all the rights, they had the inheritance, while he was only the cook.

triples.subject: Karamazov
triples.quote: What troubles me and makes me indignant is that of all the mass of facts heaped up by the prosecution against the prisoner, there is not a single one certain and irrefutable.

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: sketched for us all the arguments for and against the hypothesis of Smerdyakov’s guilt, and asked us in particular what motive he had in feigning a fit.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: He told me himself that he had helped Fyodor Pavlovitch to put the notes in the envelope.
